correctness.rationale: Every outside vertex has at most two P_n neighbors, hence at least |F|−2 neighbors inside F in the complement: all |F|≥4 are forts. Nonexistence of open twins in P_n excludes 2-element forts; singleton forts are impossible. A triple is not a fort exactly when one outside midpoint witnesses the forbidden membership 101. A quartet is inclusion-minimal iff all four triples violate the no-101 rule; sorted four-point gap constraints force its first and last gaps to equal 2 and leave middle gap ≥1, giving {a,a+2,b,b+2}. Stars-and-bars counts 101-avoiding triple words and quartets. Zero forcing equivalently has no fort subset in its initially white set: ≥4 whites fail, triples are forceable precisely when they contain 101, and 1–2 whites always clear. Independent exhaustive subset/forcing and minimal-fort checks agreed for every n=4..12; infinity follows from the proof, not the finite tests.
